channel.title: FridgePaper: Chore Charts for Kids
channel.description: Free printables from FridgePaper for the Chore Charts for Kids board.

item.title: Winter Break Chore Chart for Kids (Free Printable Game Board)
item.description: Keep kids helping all winter break! Kids color a square on a snowy game board for every chore and race to a winter prize. Picture chores, rainbow day circles, and a blank row for your own. Free printable, ready for the fridge.

item.title: Free Printable Chore Chart for Kids
item.description: Turn chores into a board game! Kids color a square every time they finish a chore and race to the treasure chest prize. Free printable weekly chore chart with picture icons, great for ages 4 to 12.

item.title: Custom Chore Chart Maker (Free, Print in 1 Minute)
item.description: Type in your child's name and chores and get a custom printable chore chart in under a minute. Free, no sign-up, works on your phone. Make a different chart for every kid.

item.title: How Much Allowance by Age? Free Allowance Calculator
item.description: Figure out a fair allowance for each of your kids in seconds. Pick a dollar amount per year of age and split it into save, spend and give. Free calculator, no sign-up.

item.title: Free Printable Toddler Chore Chart (Ages 2 to 4)
item.description: Toddlers love to help! This free printable chore chart for ages 2 to 4 has five easy jobs with pictures, big circles to color in, and a reward line. Print it and hang it at their eye level.

item.title: Free Printable Chore Chart for Teens (with Pay Tracker)
item.description: A chore chart teenagers will actually use. Real household jobs, simple check boxes, and a line to track the money they earn each week. Free to print.

item.title: Summer Chore Chart for Kids: Before Screens Checklist
item.description: End the summer screen-time battle. Kids finish their chores, reading and outside time first, then screens. Free printable summer chore chart and daily checklist.

item.title: Age-Appropriate Chores for Kids: A List by Age (2 to 16)
item.description: What chores can a 4-year-old do? A 10-year-old? A teen? A simple list of age-appropriate chores from toddlers to teens, plus tips for teaching them and free printable chore charts.

item.title: How to Make a Chore Chart That Actually Works (8 Tips)
item.description: Why do chore charts stop working after two weeks? 8 simple tips to make one your kids will keep using, plus free printable chore charts to get started today.

item.title: Winter Chore Chart Game for Kids: Color a Square, Win a Prize
item.description: A chore chart that feels like a board game. Kids color a snowy square for every job they finish and race toward a winter prize you pick together. Picture chores for little readers, plus a blank row for your own. Free printable for winter break.

item.title: Chore Chart Game Board for Kids Ages 4 to 12 (Free Printable)
item.description: Kids color a square on a game board every time they finish a chore and race to the treasure chest prize. Picture icons mean even non-readers know what to do. Free printable weekly chore chart for ages 4 to 12.

item.title: Free Personalized Chore Chart Maker: Add Your Kid's Name and Chores
item.description: Type in your child's name and their own chores, then print a custom chore chart in about a minute. Make a different chart for every kid. Free, no sign-up, and it works on your phone.

item.title: Picture Chore Chart for Toddlers and Preschoolers (Free Printable)
item.description: Five easy jobs a 2 to 4 year old can really do, each with a picture so they don't need to read. Big circles to color in and a line for their reward. Free printable chore chart to hang at toddler eye level.

item.title: Teenager Chore List and Money Tracker (Free Printable)
item.description: Teens skip charts that look babyish. This one has real household jobs, simple checkboxes, and a line to track what they earn each week, so chores connect to their own money. Free printable for teenagers.

item.title: Before Screens Checklist for Kids (Free Summer Chore Chart Printable)
item.description: Chores, reading and outside time come first, then screens. Kids check off the list themselves, so you stop being the bad guy. Free printable summer chore chart and daily checklist.

item.title: Chores for Kids by Age: A Simple List From Toddlers to Teens
item.description: Not sure what your kids can handle? A simple list of chores by age, from putting clothes in the hamper at 2 to cooking dinner at 15, plus a 4-step way to teach any new chore. Free printable chore charts too.

item.title: Chore Chart Tips: How to Get Kids to Keep Using It
item.description: Most chore charts are forgotten in two weeks. These simple fixes keep kids using theirs: fewer chores, eye-level placement, letting kids mark it, and a reward you choose together. Plus free printable chore charts.

item.title: Free Allowance Calculator: Fair Weekly Amount for Each Kid
item.description: Enter your kids' ages and pick a dollar amount per year of age. This free calculator shows a fair weekly, monthly and yearly allowance for each child, split into save, spend and give. No sign-up.
